title: SCOPE
text: SCOPE

heading: SCOPE
text: This regulation applies to:

heading: SCOPE
text: Part I: Vehicles of categories 1/ M2, M3, N2 and N3 2/ equipped with an SLD and to vehicles of categories M and N equipped with an adjustable speed limitation device ASLD which have not been separately approved according to Part III of this Regulation, or to vehicles so designed and/or equipped that their component parts can be regarded as totally or partially fulfilling the function of an SLD or ASLD, as appropriate. 1 As defined in the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3.), document ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.8 - https://unece.org/transport/vehicle-regulations/wp29/resolutions 2/ It is recommended to apply this Regulation with respect to SLDs to vehicles over 10 tonnes for which the limitation speed is less than the general speed limitation.

heading: SCOPE
text: Part II: The installation on vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 of SLDs and installation on vehicles of categories M and N of ASLD which have been type approved to Part III of this Regulation.”

heading: SCOPE
text: Part III: SLDs which are intended to be fitted to vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 and ASLD which are intended to be fitted to vehicles of categories M and N.

heading: SCOPE
text: Purpose The purpose of this Regulation is to limit the road speed of vehicles by means of a vehicle system which has the primary function of controlling the fuel feed to the engine or via the engine management.

heading: SCOPE
text: A speed limitation device (SLD) or function (SLF) shall limit the maximum speed of vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3.”

heading: SCOPE
text: When fitted, the adjustable speed limitation device (ASLD) or function (ASLF) shall limit the speed of vehicles of categories M and N to a speed voluntarily set by the driver when it is activated.

title: DEFINITIONS
text: DEFINITIONS

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: For the purpose of this Regulation:

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: " _Limitation speed V_ " means the maximum speed of the vehicle such that its design or equipment does not permit a response for an acceleration demand.

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Set speed Vset" means the intended mean vehicle speed when operating in a stabilized condition;

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Stabilized speed Vstab" means the mean vehicle speed specified in paragraph 1.1.4.2.3.3. of Annex 5 and in paragraph 1.5.4.1.2.3 of Annex 6 to this Regulation;

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Maximum speed Vmax" is the maximum speed reached by the vehicle in the first half period of the response curve as defined in the figure of annex 5 (para. 1.1.4.2.4.).

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: “Adjustable limit speed V ~~adj~~” means the speed voluntarily set by the driver.

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: “Adjustable speed limitation function ASLF”, means a function which allows the driver to set a vehicle speed Vadj, and when activated limits the vehicle automatically to that speed.

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: “Speed limitation function”, means a function to control the fuel feed of the vehicle or engine management in order to limit the vehicle speed to a fixed maximum value.

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: For the purpose of Part I of this Regulation:

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Approval of a vehicle" means the approval of a vehicle type with regard to speed limitation;

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: For the purpose of Part II of this Regulation:

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Approval of a vehicle" means the approval of a vehicle type with regard to the installation of an SLD of a type approved in accordance with Part III of this Regulation,

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: For the purpose of Part I and Part II of this Regulation:

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Vehicle type" means vehicles which do not differ in such essential respects as:

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: The make and type of the SLD, if any,

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: The range of speeds at which the limitation may be set within the range established for the tested vehicle,

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: The ratio of maximum engine power/unladen mass, less than or equal to that of the tested vehicle, and

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: The highest ratio of engine speed/vehicle speed in top gear, less than or equal to that of the tested vehicle;

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Unladen mass" means the mass of the vehicle in running order without crew, passengers or load, but with the fuel tank full and the usual set of tools and spare wheel on board, where applicable;

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: For the purpose of Part III of this Regulation:

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Speed limitation device (SLD)" means a device whose primary function is to control the fuel feed to the engine in order to limit the vehicle speed to the specified value;

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Approval of an SLD" means the approval of a type of SLD with respect to the requirements laid down in paragraph 21 below,

heading: DEFINITIONS
text: "Type of an SLD" means SLDs which do not differ with respect to the essential characteristics such as: The make and type of the device, The range of speed values at which the SLD may be set, The method used to control the fuel feed of the engine. PART I APPROVAL OF VEHICLES WITH REGARD TO LIMITATION OF THEIR MAXIMUM SPEED

title: APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL
text: APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL

heading: APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL
text: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to speed limitation shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by his duly accredited representative.

heading: APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL
text: It shall be accompanied by the under-mentioned documents in triplicate and by the following particulars:

heading: APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL
text: A detailed description of the vehicle type and of vehicle parts related to the speed limitation, comprising the particulars and documents referred to in annex 1 to this Regulation,

heading: APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL

title: REQUIREMENTS
text: REQUIREMENTS

heading: REQUIREMENTS
title: Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The speed limitation must be such that the vehicle in normal use, despite the vibrations to which it may be subjected, complies with the provisions of Part I of this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: In particular, the vehicle's SLD must be so designed, constructed and assembled as to resist corrosion and ageing phenomena to which it may be exposed and to resist tempering in accordance with paragraph 5.1.6. below.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The limitation threshold must not, in any case, be capable of being increased or removed temporarily or permanently on vehicles in use. The inviolability shall be demonstrated to the technical service with documentation analysing the failure mode in which the system will be globally examined. The analysis shall show, taking into account the different states taken by the system, the consequences of a modification of the input or output states on the functioning, the possibilities to obtain these modifications by failures or by voluntary violation and the possibility of their occurrence. The analysis level will be always to the first failure.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The speed limitation function and the connections necessary for its operation, except those essential for the running of the vehicle, shall be capable of being protected from any unauthorized adjustments or the interruption of its energy supply by the attachment of sealing devices and/or the need to use special tools.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The speed limitation function shall not actuate the vehicle's service braking system. A permanent brake (e.g. retarder) may be incorporated only if it operates after the speed limitation function has restricted the fuel feed to the minimum fuel position.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The speed limitation function must be such that it does not affect the vehicle's road speed if an acceleration demand is applied by the driver or ADS when the vehicle is running at its set speed.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The speed limitation function may allow normal accelerator control for the purposes of gear changing.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: No malfunction or unauthorised interference shall result in an increase in engine power above that demanded by the driver or ADS.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The speed limitation function shall be obtained regardless of the accelerator control used if there is more than one such control which may be reached from the driver's seating position, or regardless of any form of demand by the ADS.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The speed limitation function shall operate satisfactorily in its electromagnetic environment without unacceptable electromagnetic disturbance for anything in this environment.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: The applicant for approval shall provide documentation describing checking and calibration procedures. It shall be possible to check the functioning of the speed limitation function whilst the vehicle is stationary, (e.g. for conformity of production or periodic inspection).

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: All components necessary for the full function of the speed limitation function shall be energized whenever the vehicle is being driven.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 equipped with SLF
text: At the request of the manufacturer, vehicles of Categories X and Y may be considered to be equipped with an SLF if the ADS limits the vehicle speed to a fixed maximum value. The set speed (Vset) according to this regulation is deemed to be this fixed maximum value. Such an SLF shall be considered to fulfil the requirements of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.3. of this regulation if the ADS complies with the requirements of UN Regulation No. [ADS] according to its original version or later series of amendments, including verification of this maximum speed.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
title: Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The ASLF must be such that the vehicle in normal use, despite the vibrations to which it may be subjected, complies with the provisions of Part I of this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: In particular, the device and all components supporting the ASLF must be so designed, constructed and assembled as to resist corrosion and ageing phenomena to which it may be exposed.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The effectiveness of the ASLF shall not be adversely affected by magnetic or electric fields. This shall be demonstrated by fulfilling the technical requirements and respecting the transitional provisions of UN Regulation No. 10 by applying: (a) The 03 series of amendments for vehicles without a coupling system for charging the rechargeable energy storage system (traction batteries). (b) The 04 series of amendments for vehicles with a coupling system for charging the rechargeable energy storage system (traction batteries).

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: No malfunction or unauthorized interference with the system shall result in an increase in engine power above that demanded by the position of the driver's accelerator.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The Vadj value shall be permanently indicated to the driver and visible from the driver seat. This does not preclude temporary interruption of the indication for safety reasons or driver’s demand.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The ASLF must satisfy the following requirements:

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The ASLF shall not actuate the vehicle's service braking system except for vehicles of categories M1 and N1, where the vehicle's service braking system may be actuated.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The ASLF must be effective whichever the engine type or transmission is used.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The vehicle speed shall be limited to Vadj.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: It shall still be possible to exceed Vadj when tested in accordance with paragraph 5.3.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: To exceed Vadj a positive action will be required. */ */ e.g. kickdown”

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: Whenever the vehicle speed is exceeding Vadj the driver must be informed by means of a suitable warning signal other than the speedometer.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: Compliance with paragraph 5.2.5.4.2. shall be demonstrated by conducting the tests according to paragraph 5.3.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: Setting of Vadj:

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: It shall be possible to set Vadj value by steps not greater than 10 km/h between 30 km/h and the maximum design speed of the vehicle.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: In the case of vehicles manufactured for sale in any country where imperial units are used, it shall be possible to set Vadj value by steps not greater than 5 mph between 20 mph and the maximum design speed of the vehicle.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: This shall be achieved by a control device operated directly by the driver.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: Activation / de-activation:

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The ASLF must be capable of being activated/de-activated at any time, except whilst an ADS feature is active.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The ASLF must be de-activated each time the engine is stopped by a deliberate action of the driver.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: When the ASLF is activated the initial setting of Vadj shall not be less than the current vehicle speed.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The ASLF shall be deactivated upon activation of an ADS feature, and shall not be able to be activated whilst an ADS feature is active. 5.3. <u>Tests</u>

title: The speed limitation tests (retain former paragraph of the current regulation for SLD)
text: The speed limitation tests (retain former paragraph of the current regulation for SLD)

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF
text: The adjustable speed limitation tests to which the vehicle presented for approval are submitted are described in annex 6 of this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for vehicles equipped with ASLF > The speed limitation tests (retain former paragraph of the current regulation for SLD)
text: Three different speeds will be chosen for the tests at the discretion of the technical service.

title: MODIFICATIONS OF VEHICLE TYPE AND EXTENSION OF APPROVAL
text: MODIFICATIONS OF VEHICLE TYPE AND EXTENSION OF APPROVAL

heading: MODIFICATIONS OF VEHICLE TYPE AND EXTENSION OF APPROVAL
text: Every modification of the vehicle type shall be notified to the administrative department which approved the vehicle type. The department may then either:

heading: MODIFICATIONS OF VEHICLE TYPE AND EXTENSION OF APPROVAL
text: Consider that the modifications made are unlikely to have an appreciable adverse effect and that in any case the vehicle still complies with the requirements, or

heading: MODIFICATIONS OF VEHICLE TYPE AND EXTENSION OF APPROVAL
text: Require a further test report from the technical service responsible for conducting the tests.

heading: MODIFICATIONS OF VEHICLE TYPE AND EXTENSION OF APPROVAL
text: Confirmation or refusal of approval, specifying the alteration, shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 4.3. above to the Parties to the 1958 Agreement which apply this Regulation.

heading: MODIFICATIONS OF VEHICLE TYPE AND EXTENSION OF APPROVAL
text: The competent authority issuing an extension of approval shall assign a series number to each communication form drawn up for such an extension and inform thereof the other Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in annex 1 to this Regulation.

title: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Every vehicle approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraph 5 above.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: In order to verify that the requirements of paragraph 7.1. are met, suitable checks of the production shall be carried out.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The holder of the approval shall, in particular:

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
title: Ensure existence of procedures for effective quality control of the vehicle,
text: Ensure existence of procedures for effective quality control of the vehicle,

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Have access to the testing equipment necessary for checking conformity to each approved type;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that test result data are recorded and that the annexed documents remain available for a period to be determined in agreement with the administrative department,

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Analyse the results of each type of test, in order to verify and ensure the consistency of characteristics of the vehicle, making allowance for permissible variations in industrial production;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that for each type of vehicle sufficient checks and tests are carried out in accordance with the procedures approved with the competent authority,

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that any set of samples or test components giving evidence of non-conformity in the type of test in question shall give rise to a further sampling and test. All necessary steps shall be taken to restore conformity of the corresponding production.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The competent authority which has granted type approval may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied in each production unit.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: At every inspection, the test records and production records shall be presented to the visiting inspector.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The inspector may select samples at random to be tested in the manufacturer’s laboratory. The minimum number of samples may be determined according to the results of the manufacturer’s own checks.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Where the quality level appears unsatisfactory or it seems necessary to verify the validity of the tests carried out in application of paragraph 7.4.2., the inspector shall select samples to be sent to the technical service which conducted the type approval tests.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The competent authority may carry out any test prescribed in this Regulation. The normal frequency of inspections authorized by the competent authority shall be one every two years. In cases where unsatisfactory results are found during one of these inspections, the competent authority shall ensure that all necessary steps are taken to restore conformity of production as rapidly as possible.

title: PENALTIES FOR NO CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: PENALTIES FOR NO CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION

heading: PENALTIES FOR NO CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The approval granted in respect of a vehicle type pursuant to this Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements laid down in paragraph 5 above are not complied with.

heading: PENALTIES FOR NO CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: If a Contracting Party to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation withdraws an approval it has previously granted, it shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation, by means of a communication form conforming to the model in annex 1 to this Regulation.

title: PRODUCTION DEFINITELY DISCONTINUED
text: PRODUCTION DEFINITELY DISCONTINUED

heading: PRODUCTION DEFINITELY DISCONTINUED
text: If the holder of the approval completely ceases to manufacture a type of vehicle approved in accordance with this Regulation, he shall so inform the authority which granted the approval. Upon receiving the relevant communication, that authority shall inform thereof the other Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in annex 1 to this Regulation.

text: The Contracting Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation shall communicate to the United Nations secretariat the names and addresses of the technical services responsible for conducting approval tests and of the administrative departments which grant approval and to which forms certifying approval or extension, or refusal or withdrawal of approval or production definitely discontinued, issued in other countries, are to be sent. title: REQUIREMENTS
text: REQUIREMENTS

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: Requirements concerning the installation of an approved SLD.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: The SLD shall be so installed as to enable the vehicle in normal use, despite the vibrations to which it may be subjected, to comply with the provisions of Part II of this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: The information document shall indicate how inviolability of the SLD is assured. The analysis level will be always to the first failure.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: The speed limitation function shall be obtained regardless of the accelerator control used if there is more than one such control which may be reached from the driver's seating position, or regardless of any form of demand by the ADS.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: The applicant for approval shall provide documentation describing checking and calibration procedures. It shall be possible to check the functioning of the speed limitation function whilst the vehicle is stationary, (e.g. for conformity of production or periodic inspection).

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: All components necessary for the full function of the SLD shall be energized whenever the vehicle is being driven.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: The speed limitation function shall not actuate the vehicle’s service braking system. A permanent brake (e.g. retarder) may be incorporated only if it operates after the speed limitation function has restricted the fuel feed to the minimum fuel position.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: Requirements concerning the installation of an approved ASLD.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
text: The vehicle on which the approved ASLD has been installed shall meet all requirements of paragraphs 5.2.2., 5.2.4., 5.2.5.4., 5.2.6. and 5.2.7.

title: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Every vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraph 13 above.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: In order to verify that the requirements of paragraph 15.1 above are met, appropriate checks on production shall be carried out.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The holder of the approval shall in particular:

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure existence of procedures for effective quality control of the vehicles as regards all aspects relevant to compliance with the requirements set out in paragraph 13 above;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that for every approved vehicle sufficient checks are carried out regarding the installation of a type approved SLD, in such a way that all vehicles in production comply with the specifications of the vehicles submitted for type approval;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that, if the checks carried out pursuant to paragraph 15.3.2. above give evidence of non-conformity of one or more vehicles with the requirements set out in paragraph 13 above, all necessary steps are taken to restore conformity of the corresponding production.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The competent authority which granted type approval may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied for each production unit. The authority may also carry out random checks on serially manufactured vehicles in respect to the requirements set out in paragraph 13 above.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Where unsatisfactory results are found during verifications and checks pursuant to paragraph 15.4. above, the competent authority shall ensure that all necessary steps are taken to restore conformity of production as rapidly as possible.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The normal frequency of inspections authorized by the competent authority shall be one every two years. In cases where unsatisfactory results are found during one of these inspections, the competent authority shall ensure that all necessary steps are taken to restore conformity of production as rapidly as possible.

text: APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL OF AN SLD

text: The application for approval of an SLD must be submitted by the manufacturer of the SLD or by his duly accredited representative.

title: REQUIREMENTS
text: REQUIREMENTS

heading: REQUIREMENTS
title: General
text: General

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: The SLD shall be so designed, constructed and assembled as to enable the vehicle in normal use, fitted with the SLD, to comply with the provisions of Part III of this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: In particular, the SLD must be so designed, constructed and assembled as to resist corrosion and ageing phenomena to which it may be exposed and to resist tampering in accordance with paragraph 21.1.6.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: The set speed Vset must not, in any case, be capable of being increased or removed temporarily or permanently on vehicles in use. The inviolability shall be demonstrated to the technical service with documentation analysing the failure mode in which the system will be globally examined. The analysis shall show, taking into account the different states taken by the system, the consequences of a modification of the input or output states on the functioning, the possibilities to obtain these modifications by failures or by voluntary violation and the possibility of their occurrence. The analysis level will be always to the first failure.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: The SLD and the connections necessary for its operation, except those essential for the running of the vehicle, shall be capable of being protected from any unauthorized adjustments or the interruption of its energy supply by the attachment of seals and/or the need to use special tools.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: The SLD shall not actuate the vehicle's service braking system. A permanent brake {e.g. retarder) may be actuated only if it operates after the speed limitation device has restricted the fuel feed to the minimum fuel position.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: The SLD must be such that it does not affect the vehicle's road speed if an acceleration demand is applied by the driver or ADS when the vehicle is running at its set speed.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: The SLD may allow normal accelerator control for the purposes of gear changing.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: No malfunction or unauthorised interference shall result in an increase in engine power above that demanded by the driver or ADS.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > General
text: The SLD shall operate satisfactorily in its electromagnetic environment without unacceptable electromagnetic disturbance for anything in this environment.

heading: REQUIREMENTS
title: Requirements for ASLDs
text: Requirements for ASLDs

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The adjustable speed limitation device ASLD must be such that the vehicle in normal use, despite the vibrations to which it may be subjected, complies with the provisions of Part III of this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: In particular, the ASLF must be so designed, constructed and assembled as to resist corrosion and ageing phenomena to which it may be exposed.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The effectiveness of the speed limitation function shall not be adversely affected by magnetic or electric fields. This shall be demonstrated by fulfilling the technical requirements and respecting the transitional provisions of UN Regulation No. 10, by applying: (a) The 03 series of amendments for vehicles without a coupling system for charging the rechargeable energy storage system (traction batteries). (b) The 04 series of amendments for vehicles with a coupling system for charging the rechargeable energy storage system (traction batteries).

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: No malfunction or unauthorized interference shall result in an increase in engine power above that demanded by the position of the driver's accelerator.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The Vadj value shall be permanently indicated to the driver by a visual display. This does not preclude temporary interruption of the display for safety reasons.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The ASLD must respect the following requirements:

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The adjustable speed limitation device shall not actuate the vehicle's braking system except for vehicles of categories M1 and N1, where the vehicle's service braking system may be actuated.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The method used to limit speed when reaching Vadj must be possible whichever transmission type (automatic or manual) of the vehicle.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The vehicle speed shall be limited to Vadj.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: It shall still be possible to exceed speed Vadj.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: To exceed Vadj a positive action will be required. */ */ e.g. kickdown”

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: Whenever the vehicle speed exceeds Vadj the driver must be informed by means of a suitable warning signal other than the speedometer.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: Compliance with paragraph 21.2.5.4.2. shall be demonstrated with paragraph 21.3.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The speed limitation function shall permit a normal use of the accelerator control for gear selection.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: Setting of Vadj:

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: It shall be possible to set Vadj value by steps no greater than 10 km/h (5 mph) between 30 km/h (20 mph) and the maximum design max speed of the vehicle.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: In the case of vehicles manufactured for sale in any country where imperial units are used, it shall be possible to set Vadj value by steps not greater than 5 mph between 20 mph and the maximum design speed of the vehicle.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: This shall be achieved by a control device operated by the driver.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
title: Activation / de-activation
text: Activation / de-activation

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs > Activation / de-activation
text: When Vadj is set by the driver it shall not capable of being modified by any means other than the designated control device.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs > Activation / de-activation
text: The ASLD must be capable of being activated/de-activated at any time, except whilst an ADS feature is active.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs > Activation / de-activation
text: The ASLD must be de-activated at each engine stop and the key removed.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs > Activation / de-activation
text: The ASLD shall be deactivated upon activation of an ADS feature, and shall not be able to be activated whilst an ADS feature is active. 21.3. <u>Tests</u>

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The speed limitation tests to which the SLD presented for approval is submitted as well as the performances required are described in annex 5 to this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs
text: The adjustable speed limitation tests to which the ASLD presented for approval are submitted are described in annex 6 of this Regulation.

heading: REQUIREMENTS > Requirements for ASLDs > Activation / de-activation
text: Three different speeds will be chosen for the tests at the discretion of the technical service.

title: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Every SLD approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraph 21 above.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: In order to verify that the requirements of paragraph 23.1 are met, suitable checks of the production shall be carried out.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The holder of the approval shall, in particular:

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure existence of procedures for effective quality control of the SLD;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Have access to the testing equipment necessary for checking conformity of each approved type;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that test result data are recorded and that the annexed documents remain available for a period to be determined in agreement with the administrative service;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Analyse the results of each type of test, in order to verify and ensure the consistency of the SLD characteristics, making allowance for permissible variations in industrial production;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that for each type of SLD at least the constituent materials and the method of assembly correspond to the SLD approved. If necessary the tests prescribed in paragraph 1 of annex 5 to this Regulation shall be carried out;

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Ensure that any set of samples or test components giving evidence of non-conformity in the type of test in question shall give rise to a further sampling and test. All necessary steps shall be taken to restore conformity of the corresponding production.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The competent authority which has granted type approval may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied in each production unit.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: At every inspection, the test records and production records shall be presented to the visiting inspector.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The inspector may select samples at random to be tested in the manufacturer's laboratory. The minimum number of samples may be determined according to the results of the manufacturer's own checks.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: Where the quality level appears unsatisfactory or it seems necessary to verify the validity of the tests carried out in application of paragraph 23.4.2. the inspector shall select samples to be sent to the technical service which conducted the type-approval tests.

heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
text: The competent authority may carry out any test prescribed in this Regulation. The normal frequency of inspections authorized by the competent authority shall be one every two years. In cases where unsatisfactory results are found during one of these inspections, the competent authority shall ensure that all necessary steps are taken to restore conformity of production as rapidly as possible.

heading: Annex 5 TESTS AND PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS
text: Tests of speed limitation At the request of the applicant for approval, tests shall be made in accordance with either paragraphs 1.1., 1.2. or 1.3. below. For vehicles of Categories X and Y, all tests in this annex shall be conducted, and all respective requirements shall be fulfilled. In the absence of manual driving controls, tests shall be conducted using dedicated activation methods, which may include: (a) A test mode allowing to manually control or trigger the acceleration functions, or (b) Any other method subject to agreement between the vehicle manufacturer and the technical service, ensuring that the evaluation accurately reflects real-world ADS performance. Wherever this annex details a manual control being actuated or an action being applied on it, that shall be understood as an acceleration demand being made through the selected activation method above. The manufacturer shall demonstrate that the test activation method accurately replicates ADS performance, and a detailed description of the method used shall be included in the test report. The acceleration demand made shall be recorded in the test report alongside the results of each test. For vehicles equipped with an ADS, other than those of Categories X and Y, the tests in this annex shall be performed at least in the manual driving mode. Tests do not have to be performed in ADS mode providing the manufacturer can demonstrate to the technical service that the same SLF performance can be achieved when acceleration demands are made by the ADS. However, testing to verify this shall be performed at the request of the technical service.

text: The vehicle shall be driven at full acceleration up to the steady speed, then shall be maintained at this speed without any modification on the test basis of at least 400 metres.
